messages.subject: The markovchain package for R
parts:
Hi,

This is to inform the admins that I would like to be a GSoC mentor for the project on markovchain this year, as per the instructions on the wiki for mentors.
Mr Spedicato (main author of the package and GSoC mentor for the same in the past 2 years) has agreed to be a backup mentor, should our proposal be accepted.
We have yet to find students.

Thanks and regards,
Sai Bhargav
